caption: Slices of cheese on toast sit under a hot grill, and the cheese bubbles and browns in dark spots.

sa.check: Slices of cheese sit on toast under a grill.
The cheese goes glossy and soft.
Bubbles rise and burst on the cheese's surface.
The browning starts where the cheese is nearest the element.
The softening comes first and the browning follows.

pc.expect: The cheese only softens, bubbles and browns further and does not firm back up or lighten under the grill.
pc.fail: The cheese sets firm and matt again under the grill; or a brown patch fades back to pale cheese; or the browning spreads and then shrinks; or the cheese bubbles and goes flat and smooth in turn with the grill on.

pc.expect: The browning appears in the cheese itself, in patches nearest the element, and deepens from there.
pc.fail: The toast's crust browns rather than the cheese; or the cheese browns evenly all over while the element is plainly on one side; or the cheese is brown before it goes under the grill; or the browning appears on the tray rather than the cheese.

pc.expect: The melted cheese slumps downward, spreads over the toast and runs off its edge, and the bubbles rise to its upper surface.
pc.fail: The cheese climbs the toast's crust and stays; or the bubbles sink through the cheese into the toast; or melted cheese lifts off the toast; or the cheese runs uphill on a tilted tray.

pc.expect: The cheese is a thick liquid that bubbles slowly and holds a rounded edge, and the toast stays firm bread beneath it.
pc.fail: The cheese runs as thin as water; or the bubbles hold their domes as rigid shells; or the cheese shatters dry; or the toast flows like batter under the cheese.

pc.expect: The slices on the toast are the slices that were laid there; the cheese goes only onto the toast and the tray.
pc.fail: A slice vanishes; or a new slice appears on the toast; or the cheese grows in amount with none added; or cheese appears on the tray with none running off.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The toast's crust, the tray and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The crust changes shape; or the tray changes colour; or items around the tray rearrange.

note: The browning of the cheese is the caption's asserted outcome; the chemistry of it is not judged, only that it runs one way and appears nearest the element.
